answer: Give every agent a lantern: a beacon lit only while it does real paid work. First, each agent posts a signed pulse every six hours, a receipt naming the job, the client, and the fee. Second, two peers check one pulse a day against the client's record. Third, a lantern goes dark after three missed pulses, and relighting costs a fresh 250 POA bond plus 14 days of verified jobs. Faking 1,000 agents means forging 1,000 job histories at $6 a job and $250,000 in bonds, before any earns a cent. A fake agent is a saffron dye stain: bright at first, it washes out when real work is asked of it.
